No. P.H. /2409 /2R-11/74.—20th September 1974.- -In exercise of the power 
conferred by sub-section (1), and in particular, by clauses (a) and (e) of aub- 
section (2), of section 64 of the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) 
Act, 1974 (6 of 1974), the Governor is pleased hereby to make the following 
rules, namely: 


RULES 


1. Short title and commencement.—({1) These rules may be called the West 
Bengal Prevention and Control of Water Pollution (Conditions of Service and 
Emoluments and Allowances of Chairman, Members and Member-Secretary of 
the Board) Rules, 1974. 


(2) They shall come into force on 20th September 1974. 


2. Definitions—In these rules, unless there is anything repugnent in the 
subject or context,— 


(a) “the Act” means the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 


(b) “Board” means the West Bengal Prevention and Control of Water 
Pollution Board constituted under sub-section (1) of section 4; 


(c) “section” means a section of the Act. 


3. Terms and conditions of service of the full-tume Chairman of the Board. 
-—-(1) The Chairman shall be full-time member of the Board and his tenure of 
service shall be regulated as laid down in section 5 of the Act. 


(2) The post shall be filled up by the State Government by deputation of an 
cfticer of the State Government possessing qualifications as laid down in 
clause (a) of sub-section (2) of section 4. 


4. Terms and conditions of service of the Member-Secretary of the Board. 
—(1) The Member-Secretary shall be a full-time member of the Board. 


(2) The post shall be filled up by the State Government by deputation of 
ai officer of the West Bengal Senior Public Health Engineering Service (Civil) 
possessing the qualifications as laid down in clause (f) sub-section (2) of 


section 4. 


(3) The emoluments of the Member-Secretary shall be regulated by the 
rules of the State Government in this behalf. 


(4) Other service conditions of the Member-Secretary shall be the same as 
applicable to permanent officers of the State Government under the West 
Bengal Service Rules. 


5. Fees of attendance at meetings.—A fee of fifty rupees shall be paid to 
each member other than the Chairman and the Member-Secretary of the 
Board who attends any meeting of the Board at which a quorum is present 
and business is transacted, and at which he is present from the beginning to 


the end thereof:

6. Travelling Allowance of member other than the Chairman and the 
Member-Secretary.—(1) Every member of the Board, other than the Chairman 
and the Member-Secretary, shall be entitled to travelling allowances for journey 
undertaken in respect of the affairs of the Board. 


(2) The rates of travelling allowances shall be the following, namely:

officers of the State Government; 


Provided that if a member of the Board is a member of the Parliament 
or a member of the State Legislature his travelling allowances shall 
be governed by Appendix I of the West Bengal Service Rules, 
Part II. 


7, Leave of absence.—leave of absence may be granted— 


(a) by the Chairman to a member of the Board including the Member- 
Secretary, and 


(b) by the State Government to the Chairman of the Board.

6. Financial Power of the Member-Secretary,—(1) The Member-Secretary may purchase any one article not 
exceeding one hundred rupees in value. No expenditure exceerling one hundred rupees shall be incurred and no 
article the value of which exceeds one hundred rupees shall be purchased by the Member-Secretary without the previous 
sanction of tho Chairman. 


(2) A bill or any other voucher presentod as a claim for money shall be received and examined by the Momber- 
Secretary. If the olaim be for a sum not exceeding one hundred rupees he shall pay it. If the claim be for a sum 
exceeding one hundred rupees payment shall not be made until it has been examined and passed by the Chairman.

by sub-section (1) of section 144 of the Code of

portion of it, to be used as burial or cremation 
ground, private or public, or allow any shrine, 
masjid, church or temple to be erected thereon. 


11. The Board shall allow any person authorised 
by the Public Works Department of this Govern- 
ment to inspect, repair or clean the drainuge line 
and sewer tines and manholes or do any work in 
connexion therewith without any obstruction or 
hindrance.

NOTICE 


BURDWAN#—No. 208291..A. /(P.W.)2R-1/74.—30th 
September 1974.—Whereas8 ۰7210 hectares (21 -55acres), 
more or less, of land situated in or near the villages of 
Alisha, Gopalnagar, Bamchandaipur and SBecharhat 
described below have been requisitioned under sub-

quisition and Asquisition) Act, 1948, by the person 
authorised under section 3(1 A) of the Act for the public 
purpose of providing facilities for transport and com- 
munication, namely, for the construction of Burdwan 
Bye Passto N. H. 2; 


Now, therefore, notice is hereby given that in pur- 
suance of section 4 of the said Act, the Governor 
acquires such land being required for a public purpose 
as aforesaid;
